desc: A design that celebrates modern simplicity, the Facet cuts out the bulk without sacrifice to quality. A true gentleman's carry whose name derives from meaning a small plane surface. Features Assisted Opening, the Facet deploys fast, making it ready for whatever challenges are thrown your way; IKBS ball bearing pivot deploys the blade smooth; D2 blade steel for excellent edge retention; stainless steel handle withstands hard use and frame lock utilizes a thick lock bar to secure the blade, Includes pocket clip.
